extension.summary: Lumen: a cinematic, glass-and-light skin inspired by modern tvOS media players.
extension.description: Lumen is a fast, artwork-first skin built on Estuary's window coverage. Full-bleed backdrops, lifted poster cards, frosted dialogs and a minimal player overlay, tuned to stay smooth on low-power devices like the Raspberry Pi.
extension.disclaimer: Derived from Kodi's Estuary skin by phil65 and Piers.
